name: Black Friday
description:
An exclusive art drop edition for Black Friday 2023 from OG crypto artist Rhea Myers.

Every Black Friday, we are encouraged to buy. The one thing we cannot buy on Black Friday is Black Friday itself. But what if we could?

_Black Friday Sale_ allows anyone to do so. You can own Black Friday, or its image. It can be yours forever, secured on the blockchain as surely as if you had right-click-saved it.
